items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher invited me in to the band to replace Don.

ctx.x: Yes, I did, because then when Don finally went with McKinney's Cottonpickers, Fletcher invited me in to the band to replace Don.
Uh huh. And then of course, you had already been with McKinney's Cottonpickers before that.
